profile.summary: Madras Fertilizers Limited manufactures and trades fertilizers in India. The company offers ammonia, urea, and complex fertilizers; bio-fertilizers; and organic fertilizers under the brand name VIJAY. It also engages in the trading of agro chemicals, organic manure, and city compost. The company markets its products through dealers.
